# Cullum & Co — Scott Cullum

> I'm Scott Cullum. Cullum & Co is my practice. I work across design, engineering, and product, combining creative instincts and technical judgment with hands-on building.

I help teams decide what's worth making, test ideas early, and turn them into working products. Most clients bring me in part-time for senior direction and hands-on support. I stay close to the work, bringing in trusted collaborators and using AI agents when the engagement calls for them.

## How I help

- Fractional advisory for product and technology leaders
- AI-native exploration and prototyping
- Capability support for teams adopting modern workflows
- Technical direction across front-end architecture and experience quality
- Flexible team support through trusted collaborators
